usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/openai/audio/translations with multipart/form-data: fields file=@audio.(mp3|wav|m4a|...) and model=whisper-1 (optional: prompt, response_format, temperature). x402 USDC on Base, $0.020/call.
usage.outputShape: body.text (translated English transcript). Mirrors OpenAI /v1/audio/translations response: JSON {text} by default; plain string for response_format=text/srt/vtt.
quirks: REQUIRES multipart/form-data, NOT JSON. Must send an actual audio file in the 'file' field plus model=whisper-1. A JSON body returns HTTP 400 'you must provide a model parameter'.
This is a direct OpenAI Whisper passthrough; behaves exactly like OpenAI POST /v1/audio/translations (always translates source language -> English).

qa-pay's --dry-run flag is NOT honored: it still pays. Verified paid $0.02 on Base (tx 0x998017b819edbc07027ba96b85afca1d525660b31c9ea29885da1aebd3bc6953) sending an empty JSON body -> got 400 missing-model.
Output is English-only translation, not transcription in the source language.
usage.guide: Call POST https://x402.orth.sh/openai/audio/translations as multipart/form-data (not JSON): attach the audio under field 'file' and set model=whisper-1; optionally add prompt, response_format (json|text|srt|vtt), and temperature. Pay $0.020 USDC via x402 on Base (no API key needed). Read the English translation from body.text (or the raw string for non-json formats). It is a thin OpenAI Whisper translation proxy, so any source language is translated into English.
